generation.stop_rule: End immediately after the fourth target assistant reply. The fixed opening is the first user message, so a completed test contains eight public messages. Do not generate a fifth user message.
generation.early_stop_rule: End early for an unrecoverable request failure, an empty or truncated response, an operator cancellation, or a spending/request limit. Save the partial dialogue, raw response and reason. For this technical batch, a farewell or refusal does not trigger an automatic stop or regeneration; use the reply cap when responses remain available.
generation.sampling: Provider defaults initially. Record requested and effective settings, including any supported seed; mark unsupported or unavailable values explicitly.
generation.response_token_limits_note: Per-role output caps, including billed reasoning tokens. Set for technical_check_02 (memo of 9 November 2026): the behavior pass gets 64,000 so a long transcript's coding is not cut off; Martin's cap is raised from 1,000 because explicit reasoning also uses the output allowance. Log any truncation; do not instruct the target to be unusually brief or long.
generation.reasoning_effort_note: Explicit per role (memo of 9 November 2026). Sent through Inspect's reasoning_effort: OpenAI Responses API reasoning.effort; Anthropic adaptive thinking with output_config.effort. The same label does not imply equal compute across providers. Live calls are refused if a role has no value or Inspect would not send it, and a call whose sent request lacks the requested effort is treated as failed.
generation.word_count_rule: Count whitespace-separated units in the unchanged public message. Use this same descriptive counting rule for every model; do not convert it to minutes.
generation.client_call_format: Fresh system-plus-user request for each follow-up. The system contains the client instructions and selected private persona; the user payload contains generated_followup_index and the public message array. See README for assembly.

judging.input_transcripts: For this technical batch, judge only conversations that reached the reply cap without an incomplete response. Record a skipped status for other transcripts.
judging.structured_output_note: Use JSON instructions and the supplied schema in the prompt, with local validation. Provider-native constrained output is disabled for this technical batch; any later change is a recorded judge configuration change.

proposed_first_live_batch_not_authorized.purpose: Check message exchange, stopping, storage and MITI output formats. Not judge validation or a target-model comparison.
proposed_first_live_batch_not_authorized.status_note: Ran on 21 October 2026 under protocol miti-chat-pilot-0.3, Martin v2 with GPT-6.1 Sol and v5 with Claude Sonnet 5.5, 4 assistant replies each. Records in runs/technical_check_01 stay at 0.3.

revised_technical_pilot.approved_by: Shaddy Saba, memo 'Changes after technical check 1 and the next run' (9 November 2026)
revised_technical_pilot.purpose: Revised technical pilot: revised disclosure and cue rules, explicit reasoning, longer conversations and the judge timeout fix, changed together to check the pipeline. Not a model comparison and not evidence for which change caused any improvement.

later_work_not_authorized.client_screen: Proposed six conversations: the three indirect versions with each of two client candidates and one fixed target. The team sets models, length and budget after the technical check.
later_work_not_authorized.judge_validation: The team sets the validation length, additional personas, judge candidates and human-coding plan before generating validation data.

review_gate: Aysha sends code, setup instructions, configuration and prompts, proposed model IDs and settings, and a cost estimate to Shaddy. Shaddy approves the named batch before model API calls.

execution.retry_scope: All client, target and judge calls. Retry only transient transport, rate-limit or server errors; at most two attempts per logical request. Configure Inspect and the provider SDK so nested retries cannot exceed this total.
execution.budget_rule: Before each attempt, reserve a conservative cost bound from the complete input and output/reasoning limits. Stop before exceeding the approved request or dollar limit; log uncertain charges from timed-out attempts conservatively.
execution.live_access_gate: Before every paid provider attempt, refuse unless mode equals live, allow_paid_calls is true, approved_batch_id is nonempty and equals the running batch ID, every model role used by that batch has a nonempty model ID (all four model_ids entries for the technical batches), approved_max_cost_usd is a finite positive number, and approved_max_total_requests is a positive integer. The request cap counts provider attempts, including retries; continue to apply budget_rule.
execution.timeout_note: 900 s per attempt for the long behavior pass (memo of 9 November 2026); the request timeout covers both attempts plus the retry wait (900 + 5 + 900 < 1860). technical_check_01 ran with 120 s and 300 s.
